caption: The drawing depicts an iron trivet with three distinct views and a scale at the center. The object has a triangular shape with rounded corners and features an openwork design consisting of curved and geometric patterns in the central area. Around the border, raised lettering reads “COLEBROOKDALE IRON CO. POTTSTOWN, PA.” The iron trivet is illustrated in two perspectives: a top-down view at the top of the drawing and a three-quarters perspective below, showing more depth and the shape of the sides. Between these views is a horizontal, profile section that shows the thickness and the small, integral feet of the trivet. A ruler marked in inches and fractions of inches is included near the profile view. The drawing uses shades of gray, with subtle shading and linework to indicate texture and dimensionality. There is a small handwritten name, "J. STALOFF," in the lower left corner. The background is an off-white or light beige.
title: Flat Iron Holder
